concepts.name: Number operations review
concepts.description: Apply integer and fraction operations needed for algebraic manipulation.

concepts.name: Arithmetic order of operations
concepts.description: Evaluate expressions using brackets, exponents, multiplication, division, addition, and subtraction in order.

concepts.name: Variables and algebraic notation
concepts.description: Interpret letters as quantities and translate statements into algebraic expressions.

concepts.name: Substitution in expressions
concepts.description: Replace variables with numeric values and evaluate expressions accurately.

concepts.name: Simplifying like terms
concepts.description: Combine like terms in one-variable expressions.

concepts.name: Distributive property
concepts.description: Expand or factor simple expressions using multiplication over addition and subtraction.

concepts.name: Solving one-step equations
concepts.description: Solve equations using inverse operations in a single step.

concepts.name: Solving two-step equations
concepts.description: Solve equations requiring two inverse-operation steps.

concepts.name: Equations with variables on both sides
concepts.description: Rearrange and solve linear equations where variables appear on both sides.

concepts.name: Representing inequalities
concepts.description: Interpret inequality symbols and place solution sets on a number line.

concepts.name: Solving one-variable inequalities
concepts.description: Solve and interpret simple inequalities.

concepts.name: Coordinate plane basics
concepts.description: Locate ordered pairs and interpret quadrants on the Cartesian plane.

concepts.name: Patterns and input-output tables
concepts.description: Identify algebraic patterns from numeric relationships and tables.

concepts.name: Linear relationships
concepts.description: Recognize constant rate of change in tables, graphs, and equations.

concepts.name: Slope from graphs
concepts.description: Interpret steepness and calculate slope from two points or a graph.

concepts.name: Slope from tables
concepts.description: Calculate and verify slope using tabular changes.

concepts.name: Slope-intercept form
concepts.description: Interpret and use y = mx + c style equations.

concepts.name: Graphing linear equations
concepts.description: Plot lines from equations or intercept and slope information.

concepts.name: Writing equations from contexts
concepts.description: Model real situations with linear equations.

concepts.name: Systems concept introduction
concepts.description: Interpret the meaning of two simultaneous linear equations.

concepts.name: Solving systems by graphing
concepts.description: Find intersections of linear equations graphically.

concepts.name: Solving systems by substitution
concepts.description: Solve simple simultaneous equations using substitution.

concepts.name: Rate of change in word problems
concepts.description: Use slope to reason about rates in contextual problems.

concepts.name: Interpreting linear models
concepts.description: Explain slope and intercept meaning in a modeled scenario.
